Author: jFray
Name: EchoMix
Description: An interactive DJ deck with live mixing tools, custom playlists, and a synced listener mode with an audio visualizer.
Punchline: Spin tracks and let the party sync in.
Changelog:
Added
- A Refresh button on the DJ list.

Changed
- The DJ list is shuffled rather than ordered by likes and follows, and reshuffles every six hours. DJs who are live still come first.
- Most Followed and Most Liked now come first under Browse > Stats.

Fixed
- A DJ who had set no genres had their About text shown where their genres go.
- Genres on the DJ list and on profiles showed in whatever case they were typed.
- A DJ who ended their show stayed marked live on the DJ list until you restarted the plugin.

Author: jFray
Name: EchoSim
Description: Simulates a full-length fight for your job using your own gear or a best-in-slot preset, then reports the DPS and shows exactly where it came from. Compares gear, melds and consumables, checks your openers and burst windows, and analyses an FFLogs report against the simulated ceiling. Kills on supported encounters can be scored and submitted to per-job leaderboards.
Punchline: Simulate your rotation, then see how your real kills measure up.
Changelog: EchoSim now reads action names in English whatever language you play in. Playing in anything else, most of your rotation went unrecognised - which left leaderboard scores badly inflated and action icons missing.

Author: jFray
Name: EchoNav
Description: Lists the Critical Encounters and FATEs running in Occult Crescent: North Horn and walks you to any of them with a single click, choosing between walking, an aetheryte hop and Occult Return. Also tracks the pot cycle, keeps your knowledge-crystal buffs topped up, and can step around monsters and pick up coffers on the way. Does nothing outside North Horn.
Punchline: See what's up in North Horn, then click once to get there.
Changelog:
The aetheryte network now works whatever language you play in. Playing in anything but English, no shard was ever found and EchoNav quietly walked everywhere instead.
Travelling to a shard you have never stood at yourself now works. It used to need you to have visited a shard before it could take you there.
The window no longer appears on the title and character select screens.

Author: jFray
Name: EchoGlam
Description: Dress your character in any item in the game from a searchable in-game wardrobe, dye every slot, edit full appearance and save named outfits. Then publish the look to a community catalogue you can browse, filter, vote on and favourite without leaving the game - and put anyone else's glamour on with one click, with a revert that is always one click away. No other plugins required.
Punchline: Build a glamour, share it, and wear anyone else's.
Changelog: Add EchoGlam Friend no longer appears when you right-click a fashion accessory, or anything else that is not a person.

Author: jFray
Name: EchoRoleplay
Description: Write a full roleplay profile for your character - name, appearance, backstory, hooks and rumours - and read anyone else's by hovering them. Set statuses that hang under your character for others to read at a glance, and keep private notes on everyone you have met.
Punchline: A roleplay profile for your character, readable at a glance.
